testcase.name: mapped alternatives cannot satisfy a two-anchor requirement or inflate coverage
pathway-only mode rejects independent interaction edges
organism traversal cannot cross excluded intermediates or reuse another genome cache
unknown organism context is not silently replaced by the universal network
each peer uses its own organism signature while the focal empty signature remains empty
